title: Standard Commercial Structure Fire Evacuation
key_actions: Activate manual pull alarm immediately if not triggered.
Direct occupants away from primary fire origin and smoke-filled corridors.
Use stairwells only; do NOT use elevators under any circumstance.
Check doors for heat with back of hand before opening.
Stay low under smoke layer where breathable air is coolest.
Congregate at designated Exterior Assembly Points.
responder_guidance: Connect to exterior standpipe; isolate ventilation system to prevent smoke spread across HVAC zones.
medical_priority: Immediate airway check for smoke inhalation; burn triage.

title: START Mass Casualty Triage and AED Protocol
key_actions: Perform Simple Triage and Rapid Treatment (START) assessment.
Categorize: RED (Immediate - respiratory rate >30 or no radial pulse), YELLOW (Delayed - serious non-life-threatening), GREEN (Minor / walking wounded), BLACK (Expectant).
Deploy nearest Automated External Defibrillator (AED) for cardiac arrest.
Clear direct stretcher path to secondary medical staging area.
responder_guidance: Establish triage funnel at ground floor lobby; coordinate ambulance staging.

title: Chemical Spill and Toxic Vapor Release Protocol
key_actions: Isolate affected room/laboratory zone immediately; seal threshold.
Evacuate upwind and uphill from the chemical source.
Do NOT use water on unknown reactive chemical compounds.
Shut off local HVAC exhaust dampers.
responder_guidance: Deploy Level B/A protective equipment before entry; consult Safety Data Sheet (SDS).
medical_priority: Decontamination prior to transport; oxygen therapy for toxic inhalation.

title: High-Density Bottleneck and Crowd Crush Prevention
key_actions: Divert occupant streams to secondary emergency exits to balance corridor load.
Keep announcement cadence calm, clear, and directional.
Station wardens at bottleneck pinch points to maintain steady throughput.
Ensure all double-doors are pinned in open position.
responder_guidance: Establish unidirectional flow corridors; relieve pressure at exterior egress gates.
medical_priority: Monitor for compressive asphyxia and syncopal episodes.

title: Interior Flooding and Water Ingress Evacuation
key_actions: Move occupants to upper floors away from water ingress points.
Shut off electrical panels in affected zones if safe to do so.
Avoid basement stairwells and submerged corridors.
Deploy sandbags at entry points if authorized by building operator.
responder_guidance: Coordinate pump deployment; monitor structural load on lower floors.
medical_priority: Hypothermia and slip/fall injuries near wet surfaces.

title: Earthquake Drop-Cover-Hold and Post-Shake Evacuation
key_actions: Drop, cover, and hold on during shaking.
After shaking stops, evacuate using stairs; check for gas leaks and structural cracks.
Do not re-enter until authorized structural assessment.
Account for occupants at exterior assembly points.
responder_guidance: Rapid structural triage; isolate utilities if damage suspected.
medical_priority: Crush injuries and trauma triage at assembly points.

title: Corridor Blockage and Alternate Egress Routing
key_actions: Identify blocked corridor segments and redirect occupants to alternate exits.
Update digital twin danger zones to reflect blocked paths.
Station wardens at decision points to prevent entry into blocked routes.
Verify accessibility routes remain open for mobility-impaired occupants.
responder_guidance: Clear debris only when safe; prioritize alternate exit capacity.

title: Building-Wide Evacuation Drill and Live Emergency Protocol
key_actions: Activate building-wide alert through authorized announcement system.
Direct each zone to assigned primary or secondary exit per evacuation plan.
Conduct roll call at assembly points.
Log all deviations and blocked routes for after-action review.
responder_guidance: Maintain command post communication; update routes dynamically.
medical_priority: First aid for minor injuries during egress.
